title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A quick, classic two-player showdown. Take turns and get three marks in a row.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards, find all six pairs, and see how few moves your memory needs.

title: Number Rush
description: Race the 30-second clock and tap every number from 1 to 25 in order.

title: Meteor Dash
description: Pilot a nimble starship, collect glowing energy, and dodge a storm of falling meteors.

title: Startup Studio
description: Build a startup through eight fast-moving weeks. Balance product, marketing, research, and cash.

title: Bubble Pop
description: Pop floating bubbles, chain combos, and earn crystals in a colorful 30-second challenge.

title: Garden Glow
description: Grow animated flowers, harvest petals, and unlock new seeds in a cozy garden.
